description: The main window and every detached window. Tauri scopes capabilities per window label, and a label matching nothing here gets NO permissions — including core:default, which is what carries event:allow-listen. Such a window would mount, render, and then never receive shell:state, project:changed, or a byte of pty:data:*, with nothing in any console to say why. This glob and windows::create mint the same labels and have to change together. Note what is deliberately NOT here: updater:*. The updater plugin is registered, but only Rust calls it (src-tauri/src/updater.rs), and the frontend reaches it through the ordinary commands in that module. A permission granted to a webview that never uses it is a grant with no caller, and this one would let anything running in a window start a download and run an installer.
